RB-ERR-5XX.title: Elevated 5xx errors on an API service
steps: Check for a deploy in the 30 minutes before the alert started.
If a deploy matches, roll back to the previous version and watch the error rate for 10 minutes.
If no deploy matches, check downstream dependencies (database, payment provider) for errors.
Escalate to the owning team if the error rate stays above 5% after 20 minutes.

RB-DB-CPU.title: High CPU on a primary database
steps: List the top queries by CPU time from the slow query log.
Check whether a new query pattern started after a recent deploy.
If one query dominates, add the missing index or throttle the caller.
Do not fail over unless CPU stays above 95% for 10 minutes.

RB-LATENCY.title: High p99 latency
steps: Compare p50 and p99. If only p99 is high, look for a slow dependency or GC pauses.
Check pod CPU throttling and recent autoscaling events.
Scale out by two replicas if CPU throttling is above 20%.
